assumptions.amortization: Level monthly payment that fully amortizes the principal at origination or last refinance over the term (months = round(days x 12 / 365)) at the lender APR, compounded monthly.
assumptions.depreciation: Straight line to zero over 5 years from the original origination; the metadata's own useful life is shown separately.
assumptions.priceMethod: Per model, each source's median $/GPU-hr (Vast.ai: every verified on-demand offer, bundle price / GPUs; RunPod: secure and community list prices; Akash: the console's median), then the median across sources. H100 and H200 are SXM; RTX PRO 6000 is the Server Edition. NVL, PCIe, MIG and workstation variants are left out.

notes: Estimates from public data only: Arbitrum logs and view calls, USD.AI's public collateral metadata and app page, and public GPU rental prices.
APR is the lender tranche rate in the loan terms. Fees (origination, repayment) are not in debt service; the app's all-in APR is shown when available.
Coverage is gross of operating costs (power, hosting, staff) unless opexPerGpuHr is set, so it overstates what is left for debt service.
Market price is today's public on-demand rental price; the borrowers' actual contracts (offtake) are not public.
Not financial advice. Not affiliated with USD.AI.
